description.value: A neighbourhood pub and full-service restaurant in Port Coquitlam, The Arms Pub offers a broad daily menu of steak dinners, seafood, flatbreads, and weekend breakfast, alongside an attached liquor store stocked with cold beer, wine, and spirits. Regular entertainment nights — Tuesday trivia, Wednesday music bingo, and Saturday live bands — make it a lively community hub. Touring cyclists passing through on Coast Meridian Road would find a hearty sit-down meal and a convenient stop for cold drinks.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched from armspub.ca and confirms an active pub/restaurant with a full food and liquor store operation. The website consistently refers to the business as 'The Arms Pub', not 'Meridian Arms Pub' as in OSM — a discrepancy to flag. No cycling-specific amenities (bike rack, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so those fields are null; one vegetarian item is explicitly labelled on the menu ('Vegetarian friendly option').
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM lists 'Meridian Arms Pub' but the website consistently uses 'The Arms Pub' as the business name.
Phone number (604) 941-4711 found on website is absent from OSM tags.
OSM opening_hours tag only covers Monday–Wednesday; website states 'Open Daily at 11:00am' suggesting the OSM hours are incomplete.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The pub is clearly active and offers a full food menu suitable for touring cyclists, but no cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed from available evidence, making it a marginal WWC fit. The name mismatch between OSM and the website should also be resolved before listing.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Mushroom-Swiss Bistro Flatbread explicitly labelled 'Vegetarian friendly option' on the menu
